task_title: CI recovery scope mismatch loop bound

plan_review.notes: Plan review found the structure matched the intended fix but flagged two material gaps: KEEP needed durable suppression to avoid re-quarantine oscillation, and scope-mismatch quarantine needed trusted-author gating. Both were fixed. It also noted over-broad heuristic wording and missing disposition coverage; the heuristic was narrowed and focused restart/remove-reassign plus quarantine-entry tests were added.

rounds.notes: Initial code_review flagged that ABANDON logic should be explicitly guarded rather than relying on parseDispositionCommand only returning KEEP/ABANDON; added an explicit command !== ABANDON guard.
Second code_review flagged use of raw live instead of shouldMutate in quarantine disposition mutations; updated strip/close/restart to use shouldMutate.

Final attempted review timed out after earlier successful rounds. The surfaced comments before timeout were addressed: recovery marker replies are again retained in reviewThreadCommentDigest while blockerFingerprint canonicalizes review-thread IDs for retry accounting, and ABANDON release now writes an explicit terminal recovery state after applying lifecycle abandonment.
